programmes.show_description: Rise Above. A horse trainer and an anxious wilderness instructor tackle the jungle of Amazonia, where constant rain and a lack of resources pushes one survivalist to rock bottom. S2, Ep19
The Danger Within. A resilient mother is paired with a quirky spider-lover and dropped into Florida's remote Seminole Forest and terrorised by huge gators and 550-lb black bears. S2, Ep20

Beechcraft Airplane Salvage. The team try something a little different by bidding on a 1947 Beechcraft airplane. Mike goes a little over budget to win the auction. S7, Ep9
Lexington Burnout House. The team see what they can save from a fire-damaged house that had recently been converted to apartments. Robert and Mike get good news on an appraisal. S7, Ep10
Storm Ravaged. Stormy conditions force the miners to question how hard to fight. Shawn channels his inner MacGyver to fix a machine and Vern must make a life or death decision. S8, Ep5
Guts & Gravel. Before the winter freeze, Shawn gambles to dig deeper than ever as Ken brings the heat. The Kellys restart with a new dredge design and Emily aims to work non-stop. S8, Ep6
The Poseidon Crew dodge bushfires. The Gold Gypsies go on a night-time detecting mission. Shane and Russell push their wash plant to breaking point. S5, Ep13
Titanic Phenomenon. Jeremy Wade explores a ground-breaking scientific discovery that could change everything known about the most infamous shipwreck, the Titanic. S2, Ep6
Judgement Day. Five weeks into the king crab season change is in the air and on the Bering Sea. Big moves are made on some boats while it's the same old story on others. S9, Ep5
Fist to the Face. Jake's dark secret sets off a fistfight that throws Edgar's new captaincy into jeopardy. Meanwhile, tempers flare when Elliott grows wise to Junior's devious ways. S9, Ep6
500 Million Dollar List. Last season, Miklos located a shipwreck tied to Christopher Columbus using Cooper's intel. Now, Miklos has 8 weeks of cash left to find another shipwreck. S2, Ep1
Temple Of Doom. Josh Gates goes to the Cambodian jungle to explore the lost city of the Khmer Empire. He seeks a mystical relic believed to hold the power to incinerate enemies. S1, Ep1
The Legend of Jesse James. Josh travels across the American Midwest in search of Jesse James' legendary loot. He rappels off a cliff on Wichita Mountain and follows treasure hunters. S1, Ep2
Smoky Mountain Hope. Marty faces his most daunting challenge ever in the rescue of a Tennessee homestead. He calls on past homesteaders and a home renovation team to help. S4, Ep16
Right On The Mark. The Blacklighters' team leader, Mark, is severely injured in a mining accident forcing Paul and John to work overtime on two separate claims. S7, Ep18
Good, Bad And Overcooked. The Cheals hit a massive pocket of plate sized opal in their open cut mine. Plus, Brutal Outback temperatures cripple Cozza with severe heat stroke. S7, Ep19
No Safe Harbor. A severe arctic gale batters the fleet, forcing captains to fight extreme wind and waves. For a second time, a greenhorn's life hangs in the balance on Summer Bay. S14, Ep18
Blood Water. As rogue waves threaten to capsize their boats, Jake and Sean must make life or death decisions for their crews. Wild Bill faces a choice that could end his career. S14, Ep19
One Man, One Spear. Four harpooners compete to land a high-priced monster bluefin tuna. Niko must prove he can run a legendary boat while Joe hunts to support his family. S1, Ep1
Merciless Seas. A 30-foot wave crushes a Titan Explorer deckhand, threatening Jake's captaincy. On the Time Bandit, Johnathan loses a generator and goes dark. S20, Ep13
Jacqui and Andrews' big gold dreams are stalled by communication issues. And, the Poseidon Crew battle wet weather to unearth a monster pay day. S8, Ep6
Arachnid Overload. A survival-savvy yoga teacher and a knife maker tackle the brutal jungle of Colombia. Deadly spiders and tics test their nerve and resilience - will it break them? S2, Ep21
King of the Forest. A self-proclaimed 'king of the forest' and an endurance athlete endure the Alabama backwoods. Battling extreme hunger, they take gruesomely desperate measures. S2, Ep22

Christiansburg House. The team travels to Christiansburg to salvage an old home and get some mantels and banisters. Plus, Mike and Tay build a couch that can fit a Whiteside. S7, Ep11
Park-N-Shop Grocery Store. The Black Dog Salvage crew heads to Mike's hometown of Charlotte, North Carolina, to check out the signage they can save from his very first job. S7, Ep12
Gold Blooded. Captain Vernon is on the final leg of his epic journey transporting the Gold Ship Wild Ranger to Nome. Plus, Emily faces ripping currents and an exhausted diver. S8, Ep7
Missing In Action. When a fellow miner vanishes, Ken and Shawn interrupt their operations to join the search and rescue. Plus, Vern finally unleashes on the Bering Sea. S8, Ep8
Marcus and Linden suffer an injury that could end their road trip. The Dust Devils attempt to produce the biggest gold pour of the season so far. S5, Ep14
Curse Of The Kraken. Jeremy Wade reveals the new deep-sea discoveries that might prove the existence of the infamous giant squid. Is this underwater monster the legendary kraken? S1, Ep3
Goodbye Jake. King Crab season comes to an end and the fleet pull up their last pots. Young captain Jake Anderson struggles with the decision to leave the Northwestern. S9, Ep7
Kicking Off with a Bang. The Time Bandit crew races back to the dock after a freak accident. Will they be able to reap the rewards of the rich opilio season? S9, Ep8
Hunt For The Gold Table. After discovering a 1700s-era cannon Darrell seeks the ship's origin. A letter in Gordon's files details a 16th century wreck connected to Sir Francis Drake. S2, Ep2
World's 8th Wonder. Josh journeys from Russia to Germany in search of history's most expensive stolen object, the Amber Chamber. He retraces the steps of Nazi soldiers. S1, Ep3
Amelia Earhart. Josh Gates hunts down new evidence on the disappearance of Amelia Earhart. He starts in Papua New Guinea, ending his journey in Fiji, hoping to find her remains. S1, Ep4
Black Hills Hope. The Raneys struggle to revive a Wyoming homestead with a tragic legacy. To bring water to the property, Marty must solve the mystery of an untapped well. S5, Ep1
One Plus One Equals Three. Rod, Sam and Ben use their last dig of the season to secure enough opal for Les' retirement. Cody almost meets his demise down a 10-metre mine shaft. S7, Ep20
Rookie Mistakes. With Dan stuck at home, Justin starts the new mining season alone. He is dealt a huge blow when their rich underground mine has been pegged by another miner. S2, Ep1
Storm Surge. Captains take on the steepest waves yet in an epic final surge to hit their quotas. Jake deals with a crew injury on deck and engine failure causes trouble for Sig. S14, Ep20
Battle Of Kings Part 1. Hours before king season, a huge new boat with a renegade captain finds the crab are all in one spot. The fleet races to find the hoard. S15, Ep1
Mouse-Free Retreat. The crew head to Maine to rescue a DIY project. With a new addition and a mouse issue to fix, can the team finish before the owners' 10th anniversary? S15, Ep9
Hilltop Hybrid. The team head to the hills of Pocahontas County, West Virginia to try something new. They create a hybrid timber frame structure. S15, Ep9
An armed trespasser threatens the Gold Devils' exploration mission. Plus, the Ferals uncover the biggest gold nugget of their mining careers. S8, Ep7
